body: Had to revert this due to https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/55031

The previous change (https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/54746) always excluded HTTP calls with auth headers from caching and there was no way to opt-out of this behavior. We are temporarily reverting the change from https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/54746 to investigate how we can provide an API for developers to opt-out. We plan to land a more flexible version (likely still excluding auth requests by default) in v18.

issue.body:
This update modifies the transfer cache logic to prevent caching of HTTP requests that require authorization. To opt-out from this behaviour use the `includeRequestsWithAuthHeaders` option in `withHttpTransferCache`

BREAKING CHANGE: By default we now prevent caching of HTTP requests that require authorization . To opt-out from this behaviour use the `includeRequestsWithAuthHeaders` option in `withHttpTransferCache`.

Example:
```ts
withHttpTransferCache({
  includeRequestsWithAuthHeaders: true,
})
```

Closes: #54745
